spec.target: Success within two years at the destination (see target). Rows: successful transfers at FBS programs who were on that program's board; y = 1
spec.decision_dates: May 1 of the season the player transfers into (after the spring window). Boards hold entries filed by then; every feature uses data available then
spec.training: Fold t trains on transfer cohorts 2018 through t-2, the cohorts whose two-year outcome is complete by May 1 of season t (cohort t-1 is left out: only its first year is known; Matt, 2026-11-15). Type dimensions (F2) and system dimensions (F1) are refit each fold on seasons 2017 through t-1. The first two dimensions of each are used (the stable ones in the F1/F2 reports, fixed before any result).
spec.boards: One board per FBS program (teams_t), position (QB, RB, WR, TE by the previous-season roster), and window: every portal entrant for season t filed by May 1 and linked to a season t-1 (or t-2) roster id, whether or not he played. Ranked by the model's probability for that program.
spec.group_by: none: player and program features; the outcome rows are the test cohort's transfers, never in training

baseline_definitions.transfer_rating: portal stars, ties broken by the transfer rating; missing ranks last
baseline_definitions.raw_production: previous-season yards at his position (QB passing on dropbacks, RB rushing, WR/TE receiving)
baseline_definitions.profile_only: previous-season opponent-adjusted, shrunk efficiency composite, the same for every program; no previous production ranks last

spec.metric_definition: Recall at 10: the mean, over successful transfers, of the chance he ranks in the top 10 of his destination's board at his position. Tied scores share the places they span (credit = (10 - players strictly above) / players tied, clipped to [0, 1])
spec.gate_decided: Matt, 2026-11-15: strict, and against all three baselines: for each of transfer rating, raw production, and profile only, the 90% interval of the recall-at-10 edge (bootstrap by player) must be above zero
spec.null_baseline_note: Label-permutation null. Changed from uniform random after the first run (Matt, 2026-11-15): a shuffled-label model still beat uniform random (+0.027 over 20 seeds) because any linear ranker puts players with production at the board's extremes. The null is now the mean credit of 20 random-direction rankers on the same standardized features. The gate is unchanged.
spec.secondary: Reported, not gating: recall at 25; AUC among each program's actual transfer signees (pairs within program, position, and window); fit x role availability (probability x open share, F0); the efficient label (above the starters' average with >= 10% share, within two years); the 2025 window on the year-1 label; by position and by destination level; FCS destinations where a system exists; calibration (predicted vs. actual by decile among signees, Brier vs. the base rate).
spec.limits: The test sees only where players went, not whether a program could have signed them. About a third of successes are at FCS programs, outside the primary test. Early folds train on few transfers (2021: cohorts 2018-2019). Not seen at all: health, makeup, NIL cost, academics, film traits.
spec.reproduction: Exact on the same machine (deterministic solvers). Official runs happen in CI.

vault.note: Season 2026 outcomes are sealed: the 2025 window's second year and the 2026 window's first, scored once after the season completes (January 2027).

entity_overlap.not_applicable: group_by: none: player and program features; the outcome rows are the test cohort's transfers, never in training

universe.note: entities without an outcome (retired, injured, too few pitches) can't be scored; they're counted here so survivorship is visible
